questions.q: Which protein in plants can cause brain fog by binding to sugar molecules in the brain?
questions.why: Lectin binds sugars in the brain causing fog.

questions.q: What effect does wheat lectin have on the intestinal tract?
questions.why: Lectin increases gut permeability letting microbes escape.

questions.q: Which foods does Gundry recommend cutting out to avoid lectins?
questions.why: He advises avoiding legumes, potatoes, cucumbers, tomatoes, and wheat.

questions.q: Why does the body attack microbes that escape the gut?
a: They are seen as foreign invaders
questions.why: Escaped microbes trigger an immune response.

questions.q: What is the main reason the author says what you don't eat matters more?
questions.why: He claims wrong foods lead to harmful reactions.
